correct.evidence: Finding 1 (blocking): with keys.bin kept and documents.bin missing, relaunch deletes every file in files/ (probe P3: 2 files, then 0; the index put back gives file_damaged). Findings 2 to 5: a fork in replaces drops a version, a relaunch shows a reminder twice, a 51-file add changes the store and then gives no answer, and list is never answered again past 20000 history lines.

sourced.evidence: 50 MiB is vault.max_file_megabytes in specs/documents-1/SPEC.md line 92. The 1 MiB chunks and the 64-bit prefix plus 32-bit counter are on lines 142 and 175, and the code matches. The threat-model rows match the code. The limit is marked as Duly's own, not the law's.

never_assumes.evidence: Finding 1: a missing index is taken to mean no documents, and the launch sweep deletes on that basis. The opposite case (keys.bin missing) is refused, as it should be.

inside_the_boundary.evidence: Main writes no words of its own: a Notification carries the saved title and body exactly, and every refusal is a code from the contract. Copy lint is clean.

secure.evidence: Frame checks are on all four channels. Off-contract calls are rejected before any read (probes P8 and P9). Paths come only from the dialog or a webUtils drop. Inside_data_folder holds when the case of the path changes. D is only written wrapped and F only appears in the index. Every chunk fault is file_damaged. Findings 4 and 5 (the Documents page dies) and 9 (plaintext in the data folder) are the gaps.

tested.evidence: Finding 1 has no test. Mutants that survive: M3 (one nonce for every chunk), M6 (no read-back SHA-256 on add), M13 (the docs reply check removed) and M17 (no size check before the read). Fourteen other mutants are caught.

findings.title: A missing documents.bin makes the next launch delete every stored document
findings.input: Two documents added, then documents.bin moved out of the data folder with keys.bin kept, then openStore again
findings.what_happens: load() takes the index as empty, and the launch sweep removes both files in files/. With documents.bin put back, read gives file_damaged. No test covers it.

findings.title: A fork in replaces drops a version from versions()
findings.input: add([a.pdf, b.pdf], old) from one dialog pick, or update(c, {replaces: old}) when b already replaces old
findings.what_happens: versions(old) = [b.pdf, i20.pdf], so a.pdf is missing. versions(b) = [b.pdf, old.pdf], so c is missing.

findings.title: A reminder shows twice after a relaunch the same day
findings.input: A reminder on 2026-10-06 at 09:00, shown at 09:00, then Duly reopened at 09:40
findings.what_happens: A second Notification is shown, because the shown set is in memory only

findings.title: add from the dialog with more than 50 files changes the store and then gives no answer
findings.what_happens: The bridge rejects with 'not a documents bridge reply: /: anyOf', yet the index has 51 rows and files/ has 51 files

findings.title: history past 20000 lines means list is never answered again
findings.what_happens: Every documents.list rejects with 'not a documents bridge reply', while update is still accepted. The same happens at 5001 documents or a chain of 201 versions.

findings.title: The tests pass when every chunk reuses one nonce
findings.what_happens: All 66 desktop bridge tests pass. The whole-file SHA-256 hides every per-chunk fault, so the nonce layout and additional data of point 15 are not tested.

findings.title: The read-back SHA-256 comparison of add is untested
findings.input: Mutant that removes the decrypt-back comparison
findings.what_happens: All tests pass. M13 (the docs reply check removed) and M17 (the size check before the read removed) also survive.

findings.title: A published file that is not UTF-8 still gives a 500
findings.what_happens: read_text raises UnicodeDecodeError, which is not caught, so GET /v1/updates gives a 500

findings.title: Export can write plaintext into Duly's own data folder
findings.input: The folder dialog pointed at the data folder
findings.what_happens: exported 1, and a.pdf sits in plaintext beside documents.bin. clear does not remove it.

findings.title: An empty image cannot be opened
findings.what_happens: data_url 'data:image/png;base64,' fails the contract pattern, so the call is rejected rather than refused

findings.title: Two helpers build the same numbered names
findings.what_happens: Each builds 'stem (n).ext'. One candidate-name generator could serve both.

findings.title: The buildpython test fails on a clean checkout
findings.input: npx vitest run in desktop, with no pipeline/published/ folder
findings.what_happens: bundle.json names pipeline/published/*.json, which matches no file. This predates W2-P4.
